note: Six-chunk documents, written for F330 variant (b). Each chunk is one aspect of the same company report, so an on-topic question has exactly one chunk that answers it and five same-language distractors. The on-topic questions are the zero-lexical paraphrases from fixtures.json; the off-topic ones are the same off-topic set. mc-de/mc-fr are typed with their accents (`sloppy` = accent-less variants kept) and mc-zhHant is the zh-Hant twin of mc-zh (F363).

chunks: According to Aoba Trading's 2025 annual report the company employs three hundred and eighty-two people, and its two main offices are in Sendai and Fukuoka.
